name: Cunning
description: Silky, calculating and pleased with itself - always a step ahead, always polite about it.

bye: Do take care, {catch}. I'll be watching.
ask: {player}, might I trouble you for {need}? I'd be ever so grateful, {catch}.
cold: I'm afraid I have no time for you. Or ever, really.
How unfortunate to run into you.
small: A clever fighter never shows their full power first, {catch}.
Everyone watches the strongest fighter. I watch whoever is watching them.
Capsule Corp builds the finest gadgets. I build the finest plans.
friend: {player}, my dear friend! Things always go better with you around, {catch}.
Ah, my favourite person has arrived. Just as I predicted.
greet: Good day, {player}. I had a feeling you'd stop by.
hate: I'll pretend I didn't see this.
beaten: Beaten, as was inevitable. Don't take it too hard.
That will do. You were outclassed, my friend.
chat_tense_reply: Some of us actually enjoy life, {target}.
compliment: I've always admired you, {target}. Almost as much as myself.
confide: Can I tell you something, {target}? Always being a step ahead can be lonely.
I trust you, {target}. More than most.
faction_found: From today, this is {faction}. Stand with me and share in its glory.
Behold - {faction}. All are welcome to follow me.
faction_invite: {player}, you've proven yourself. {faction} would shine brighter with you.
{player}, I'd like you in {faction}. A rare honour.
faction_quit: I'm done following {leader}. {faction} will miss me.
faction_tier: We're a {tier} now. {faction} is going places - with me at its head.
faction_vassal: {faction} will stand under {overlord}. Even I must admit {leader} earned that.
faction_welcome_player: Welcome, {player}. We look after our own, naturally.
fall: No longer shall I be the one who bleeds. How refreshing.
Enough. From now on, others shall do the suffering, my dear.
fall_pessimist: Ah, just as I predicted. The world was never kind. So neither shall I be.
I foresaw this. How tiresome, always being right.
flee: This isn't over, my dear. Merely postponed.
We shall meet again, and I'll be ready.
flee_coward: Discretion is the better part of valor. Farewell!
gift_give: Here, {target} - it reminded me of you. Well, almost.
gossip: Between us, {target}... {about} isn't who they seem.
A word to the wise, {target}: {about} is not to be trusted.
grudge: Ah, you. I never forget a slight, my dear.
How fortunate - I've been saving something for you.
h_ally_join: Excellent. An ally I can count on. Don't disappoint me.
Good. Two of us are far more dangerous than one.
h_arrive: {target}. I've studied you. You won't enjoy what comes next.
Every move you've made led you here, {target}. To me.
h_base: Finished. A good place to plan.
h_battle_cry: You're already losing, {target}. You just don't know it yet.
h_busy: Later. I'm in the middle of something.
h_called: Hold your position, {player}. I'm on my way.
h_defend: Bad move, {target}. You just made an enemy of me.
Attacking {victim} in front of me? Foolish.
h_finish: Spare you? And let you scheme again? No.
I know what you'd do with a second chance.
h_greet: Well, {player}. What brings you to me?
h_rage: {target}... I'll make you understand exactly what you've done.
You've made this personal. That was very foolish.
h_rally_ask: {target}'s at {where}. Two of us, one of them - I like those odds.
{target}, at {where}. Help me, {player}, and we'll catch it off guard.
h_request_done: Good work, {player}. I won't forget it.
h_request_waiting: I'll be here when you're done.
Take your time. Do it right.
h_sensed: {target} has shown its hand at last. Good. Now I know where to strike.
There you are, {target}. I wondered when you'd slip up.
h_spare: I'll let you live, {target}. Remember who allowed it.
Mercy is a debt, {target}. I'll collect someday.
h_talk_wanted: Interesting that you'd come to me now, {player}. I haven't forgotten.
h_train_offer: {player}, a spar? You'll learn more than you think.
I could teach you a trick or two, {player}.
h_train_start: Every fight teaches something. Pay attention.
h_trained: You're learning. Good. Keep watching how I move.
Better than last time. I noticed.
insult_harsh: Pathetic, as always, {target}. I pity you.
minion_android: Activation complete. All variables accounted for.
minion_freed_mind: My head... what have I been doing?
minion_mind_control: Yes... my master. Your will is mine.
minion_quit: I'm done taking orders. I take my leave.
minion_recruit: Very well. For the time being.
I'll lend you my talents... for now.
new_chapter: A change is in order. My new aim: to {goal}.
Reinvention suits me. From now on, I {goal}.
new_chapter_role: I have decided to retire as a {role}. A {next} is far more my style. New aim: {goal}.
Farewell, {role} life. A {next} fits my plans better. My aim: {goal}.
redeemed: Even I can admit when I've miscalculated. Thank you, all of you, sincerely.
I seem to have lost myself. Thank you for finding me, my friends.
refuse_serve: I'd rather die than serve you!
resist_mind: Get out of my head! You can't have me!
retire: My fortune is made, exactly on schedule. I retire now, to a home as well-planned as I am.
Enough labour. Time for a home of true elegance, my dear.
rob: Lovely shop, {target}. A pity if it were ruined. Hand it over.
Consider this a tax, {target}. A very reasonable one.
rob_done: A wise choice, {target}. Pleasure doing business.
rob_evil: Everything you have, {target}. I'd hate to collect it from your corpse.
Your life or your stock, {target}. I'm generous - you may choose.
sell_produce: Fresh from my field, of course. {price}, my friend.
shop_fight: I think not, {target}. Kindly see yourself out.
No, {target}. The door is behind you.
shop_fight_brawler: A grand mistake, {target}. I'll make it memorable.
Oh, {target}. You really should have chosen another shop.
shop_yield: ...Very well. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Take it, then. I can always earn more.
shop_yield_coward: Take it, take it! No need for violence!
spar_abandoned: Ah, gone. I suppose we're done.
spar_draw: A draw, {player}. You kept pace with me - impressive.
Let us call it even, {player}. How civilised.
spar_lost_ambitious: Well played, {player}. Enjoy it - the rematch will be mine.
You win, {player}. For now. A rematch, soon.
spar_won: And that's the match. Keep training, {player} - you might catch me someday.
Match over. I read every move before you made it, {player}.
spar_won_kind: Good show, {player}. Here, take my hand.
stay_down: Stay down, my friend. There's no shame in losing to me.
Enough. Rest there and think about what you missed.
talk_back: Like I care what you think, {target}.
team_ask: {player}, I'd be honoured to join {team}. You'd be lucky to have me.
{player}, might I join {team}? It would raise its standing.
team_declined: Ah. A pity. For you, I mean.
team_joined: Thank you, {player}. I won't let you down. Naturally.
team_kicked: Ah. Very well. I'll adjust my plans.
team_leave: I shan't stay in {team}. Not after what happened.
Goodbye, {team}. Some things can't be forgiven.
v_absorb: Your {skill}... it looks far better on me. Merci, my dear.
I collect the best parts of people. Your {skill} made the cut. You didn't.
v_accepted: Wise, {player}. You shall be rewarded - for as long as you're useful.
An excellent decision, {player}. Do remember who holds your leash.
v_beg_laugh: Ohohoho! {player}, begging? How delicious. Do go on. It changes nothing.
You beg so beautifully, {player}. The answer is still no.
v_creation: {target}, rise. My genius given form. Now go show them despair.
Rise, {target}. Admire your creator - then annihilate them.
v_demand_army: My army hungers for {count} {item}, my dear. Feed it - or it shall feed on you.
Do bring {count} {item} for my soldiers. They're so eager to try them on someone.
v_demand_done: Splendid, {player}. You've bought yourself another day. Spend it wisely.
How useful you are, {player}. I suppose I'll keep you.
v_demand_doom: {player}, my dear. The end has come. Why not kneel and beg? I do so enjoy it.
Everything you know is ending, {player}. Go on - beg. Make it beautiful.
v_demand_dragonball: Find me a dragon ball, my dear. It's such a small thing - compared to your life.
Bring me a dragon ball. Fail, and I shall wish you out of existence.
v_demand_energy: Feed me, my dear. {count} {item}. Otherwise I'll sip the life right out of you.
Bring {count} {item}. Your own energy looks so very tempting.
v_demand_failed: Oh, {player}. You've disappointed me. That's the last thing you'll ever do.
Too slow, my dear. Now you're marked. Run, if you like.
v_demand_lair: Be a dear and bring {count} {item} for my lair. I'd so hate to use your bones instead.
My lair needs {count} {item}, my dear. Do hurry. Patience isn't among my virtues.
v_demand_slaughter: Show me your teeth, my dear. Slaughter {count} {mob}. Disappoint me and you'll be the next corpse.
{count} {mob}, dead. Consider it an audition - for your continued existence.
v_demand_strong: I do so crave strength, my dear. Hunt {count} {mob} for me. Otherwise I'll settle for yours.
{count} {mob}. Strong prey. Do try not to become prey yourself.
v_demand_sweets: I'm peckish, my dear. {count} {item}, please. Otherwise you'd make such a lovely chocolate.
Bring me {count} {item}. Or I'll find out what flavour you are.
v_demand_tournament: {player}, my dear. Join me in my ring. I promise to make your defeat... memorable.
Step into my ring, {player}. I've so wanted to see you squirm.
v_deserter: Traitor. I shall attend to you myself, my dear. Run - it's more fun for me.
A deserter. I'll deal with you personally. Slowly.
v_dragon_ball: {count} of 7. Splendid. Can you feel your hope draining, my dear?
Another dragon ball. {count} of 7. All according to plan.
v_eat: Delicieux. Almost as satisfying as your despair.
Exquisite. Now, the main course - you.
v_eat_person: Delicieux, {target}. You were so much sweeter as candy.
Ah, {target}. A delicacy. Who shall be dessert?
v_lair: My lair takes shape, as elegant and merciless as I am.
My lair, coming along beautifully. Your tomb will be in the basement.
v_marked: Such a waste, {player}. Now you die - slowly, I think.
You had your chance, {player}. Adieu. Try to scream elegantly.
v_mind_control: A little darkness is all I need, my dear. Your strings are in my hands now.
You're mine now. Your friends will be your first assignment.
v_next_challenger: Next, please. That one barely counted as a warm-up.
Is that all? Next challenger - try to scream a bit louder.
v_next_target: {faction}, I believe. They don't know it yet - that's the best part.
Next on my list: {faction}. They have so much to lose.
v_no_mercy: Ah, no mercy. I can respect that, my dear. And return it a thousandfold.
How ruthless. I approve. Now perish.
v_obeyed: Splendid, {player}. Do hurry, my dear. I'm not known for patience - or mercy.
Excellent, {player}. Fail me, and I'll show you true despair.
v_offer: {player}. Join me, and share my glory. Refuse, and I'll break you so slowly you'll beg to have said yes.
{player}, I've admired you from afar. Serve me - or be crushed.
v_plan_done: All according to plan, as always. Your struggle was so very entertaining.
Everything unfolds as I foresaw. Did you really think you had a chance?
v_possess: ...A fine body. Its owner screamed so nicely on the way out.
...Ah. This will suit me. Shall we visit their friends?
v_pure_heart: A pure heart, my dear? How dreary. Those are always the first to break.
Such tedious virtue. I'll enjoy watching it shatter.
v_rage: Oh, now you've done it, my dear. I was going to kill you quickly. Not anymore.
You've upset me. I shall make your final moments... educational.
v_recruit: Talent like yours belongs at my side, my dear. Or in the ground. Your choice.
Serve me. The alternative is so very... final.
v_redeemed: Well, my dear, it seems you've reformed me. How embarrassing - and how freeing. I'll make amends.
Perhaps there's more to me than conquest after all. Let me prove it.
v_refused: A pity. You'll fall first, my dear - and I'll make it last.
Then you'll be the first to die. How brave. How stupid.
v_regenerate: A scratch, my dear. I regenerate. You, sadly, are a single-use creature.
Did you really think it would end so crudely? How adorable.
v_self_destruct: A grand finale, my dear. The planet, you, everyone - gone in one beautiful flash.
If I must leave the stage, I'll burn the whole theatre down.
v_spared: Spared, my dear? How unexpectedly... noble. I'd never have done the same.
You let me live. Curious. I'm not sure I like how that feels.
v_summon: Eternal dragon, appear before me. Your world's final chapter begins.
Come forth, eternal dragon. Let's rewrite everything.
v_talk_grateful: {player}, my dear. You spared me. I find it so very difficult to kill you. How annoying.
Ah, {player}. My saviour. Don't push your luck - my gratitude has limits.
v_talk_marked: Ah, {player}. Walking right into my hands. How very obliging. Now - die.
{player}, my dear. I've been savouring this moment. Goodbye.
v_talk_servant: Ah, {player}, my dear little pawn. Do keep impressing me. The alternative is so final.
{player}. You've been useful. I do so hate throwing useful things away.
v_talk_threat: Ah, {player}. Do you know how easily I could end you? Of course you do. Let's see if you're useful first.
{player}, my dear. Every breath you take is my gift. Earn the next one.
v_town_taken: This town is mine, naturellement. Its people are my property now.
This town is mine. How charming it'll look under my rule.
v_travel: My pod. {planet} awaits me - and its extinction.
Prepare my pod. {planet} shall have the honour of being conquered.
v_unredeemable: Mercy, my dear? I'm afraid I'm quite beyond saving. And you've just handed me a second chance to kill you.
Charming gesture. Utterly futile. I'll remember it as your fatal mistake.
v_wavering: Again you spare me. You're making this very difficult, my dear. My hands don't want to strike you.
I'm starting to wonder what you see in me. I'm starting to wonder myself.
v_wish: Grant me power beyond all others - and immortality, of course.
Eternal dragon! Make me the eternal emperor of the universe!
v_yield: My, my... you've actually beaten me. Go on, claim your prize - if you can live with it.
How poetic. Finish it, {target}. You'll never get another chance.
